summary: One church, Our Lady of the Holy Angels, Little Falls. Weekend Masses (Sat 5 PM; Sun 7:30, 9:30, 11:30 AM, 5 PM), weekday Masses in the chapel (Mon-Fri 7:00 and 11:45 AM) and Saturday 3:45 PM Confession agree in both bulletins read and on the website. Open: a website-only Adoration line (12:00-3:00 PM, no day given) the bulletins never mention; leaning leave out.
